#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
LOOP 1 SMOKE TEST — MusicGen-small (Meta AudioCraft)
Generates 8 seconds of music from a text prompt.
Saves to /tmp/smoke/music.wav, prints load + generation time separately.

Shared venv: tests/venvs/shared/
Run: python3 tests/smoke_music.py

NOTE: Uses a shared venv with all 4 smoke tests to avoid 4x torch downloads
(torch alone is ~88MB; disk space is the constraint on this machine).
The shared venv IS the coexistence test — if libs conflict here, we know.
"""

import subprocess
import sys
import os
import time
import traceback
from pathlib import Path

VENV_DIR = Path(__file__).parent / "venvs" / "shared"
OUTPUT_PATH = Path("/tmp/smoke/music.wav")
OUTPUT_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

PROMPT = "melancholic piano score, slow tempo, emotional, cinematic, solo piano"
DURATION_S = 8


def ensure_venv():
    """Create shared venv and install torch + audiocraft if not done."""
    marker = VENV_DIR / ".music_ready"
    if marker.exists():
        print("[venv] MusicGen deps already installed — skipping")
        return

    base_marker = VENV_DIR / ".base_ready"
    if not base_marker.exists():
        print(f"[venv] Creating shared venv at {VENV_DIR} ...")
        subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "venv", str(VENV_DIR)], check=True)
        pip = VENV_DIR / "bin" / "pip"
        subprocess.run([str(pip), "install", "--quiet", "--upgrade", "pip"], check=True)
        # Install torch first, standalone, no extras
        print("[venv] Installing torch (this is the big one, ~88MB)...")
        t0 = time.time()
        subprocess.run(
            [str(pip), "install", "--quiet",
             "torch", "torchaudio",
             "--index-url", "https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu"],
            check=True,
        )
        print(f"[venv] torch installed in {time.time() - t0:.1f}s")
        base_marker.touch()

    pip = VENV_DIR / "bin" / "pip"
    print("[venv] Installing audiocraft + scipy...")
    t0 = time.time()
    subprocess.run(
        [str(pip), "install", "--quiet",
         "audiocraft",
         "scipy",
         "--no-deps",  # avoid pulling xformers / conflicting torch versions
         ],
        check=True,
    )
    # audiocraft needs a few transitive deps that --no-deps skips
    subprocess.run(
        [str(pip), "install", "--quiet",
         "einops", "flashy", "huggingface_hub", "omegaconf",
         "encodec", "num2words", "soundfile", "librosa"],
        check=True,
    )
    marker.touch()
    print(f"[venv] audiocraft ready in {time.time() - t0:.1f}s")


def run_in_venv():
    venv_python = VENV_DIR / "bin" / "python"
    if sys.executable != str(venv_python):
        print(f"[venv] Re-launching inside venv: {venv_python}")
        os.execv(str(venv_python), [str(venv_python)] + sys.argv)


def main():
    print("=" * 60)
    print("SMOKE TEST: MusicGen-small")
    print("=" * 60)

    ensure_venv()
    run_in_venv()

    # --- Inside venv from here ---
    import torch  # noqa: PLC0415

    device = "cpu"
    print(f"[config] device={device}  torch={torch.__version__}")
    print(f"[config] prompt: {PROMPT!r}")
    print(f"[config] duration: {DURATION_S}s")

    # Model load timing
    print("\n[load] Loading MusicGen-small (downloads ~1GB on first run)...")
    t_load_start = time.time()

    try:
        from audiocraft.models import MusicGen  # noqa: PLC0415
        model = MusicGen.get_pretrained("facebook/musicgen-small", device=device)
        model.set_generation_params(duration=DURATION_S)
    except Exception:
        print("\n[FAIL] Model load failed:")
        traceback.print_exc()
        sys.exit(1)

    t_load_end = time.time()
    load_time = t_load_end - t_load_start
    print(f"[load] Model loaded in {load_time:.2f}s")

    # Generation timing
    print(f"\n[gen] Generating {DURATION_S}s of music...")
    t_gen_start = time.time()

    try:
        with torch.no_grad():
            wav = model.generate([PROMPT])  # shape: (1, channels, samples)
    except Exception:
        print("\n[FAIL] Generation failed:")
        traceback.print_exc()
        sys.exit(1)

    t_gen_end = time.time()
    gen_time = t_gen_end - t_gen_start
    print(f"[gen] Generation complete in {gen_time:.2f}s")

    # Save output
    print(f"\n[save] Saving to {OUTPUT_PATH} ...")
    try:
        import scipy.io.wavfile as wavfile  # noqa: PLC0415
        import numpy as np  # noqa: PLC0415

        audio = wav[0].cpu().numpy()  # (channels, samples)
        if audio.ndim == 2:
            audio = audio.T  # (samples, channels) for scipy
        audio_int16 = (audio * 32767).clip(-32768, 32767).astype(np.int16)
        sample_rate = model.sample_rate
        wavfile.write(str(OUTPUT_PATH), sample_rate, audio_int16)
    except Exception:
        print("\n[FAIL] Save failed:")
        traceback.print_exc()
        sys.exit(1)

    file_size_kb = OUTPUT_PATH.stat().st_size // 1024
    print(f"[save] Saved: {OUTPUT_PATH}  ({file_size_kb} KB, {sample_rate}Hz)")

    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("RESULT: SUCCESS")
    print(f"  Model load time : {load_time:.2f}s")
    print(f"  Generation time : {gen_time:.2f}s")
    print(f"  Total wall-clock: {load_time + gen_time:.2f}s")
    print(f"  Output          : {OUTPUT_PATH}")
    print("=" * 60)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
